description: Fuselage of the Brazilian Navy's first AS332 Super Puma, UH-14 N-7070 (received 15 Apr 1987, flown by HU-2 until 2017), trucked 440 km from São Pedro da Aldeia and installed Sept 2024 in the 'helicopter capital' home of Helibras (Força Aérea, 17 Sep 2024).
aliases: UH14; AS332; AS-332; Super Puma; N7070
